description: Fetch the whole article or section a chunk belongs to (the chunk's neighbours up to the next heading of the same or a higher rank, e.g. all of Art. 18 for a hit in Art. 18(1)), with full text, pages (page changes inside a chunk marked [p. N]) and the outline path. Use it before answering from a rule that may have exceptions, conditions or special cases in other paragraphs, instead of relying on the single hit. A long section is cut to about 12,000 characters around the chunk and the chunk_ids left out are listed (fetch them with get_chunks); without recognised headings only the chunk itself comes back.

chunk_id.description: A chunk_id from a search result.

document_ids.description: Optional: restrict to these documents (ids from list_documents); they must belong to the given contexts.

name: get_section
